devdoc.details: This contract interacts with the vault to lock or unlock assets and keeps track of the fee master's total debt.

adjustVaultAssetsAndUpdateTotalFeeMaster.details: This function can only be called by the fee master contract. The fee master can use this method to lock assets into or unlock assets from the vault.

params.extAccount: External account affected by the transaction.
params.netAmount: Net amount of tokens being locked/unlocked.
params.token: Address of the token being adjusted.

constructor.details: Constructor sets vault and fee master contract addresses.

params.feeMaster: Address of the fee master contract responsible for fee calculations.
params.vault: Address of the vault contract responsible for holding assets.

returns._0: The total debt of the fee master for the specified token.

devdoc.title: FeeMasterTotalDebtController

adjustVaultAssetsAndUpdateTotalFeeMaster.notice: Adjusts vault assets based on net amount and updates fee master debt.

getFeeMasterDebt(address).notice: Retrieves the total debt associated with the fee master for a given token.

userdoc.notice: Manages the total debt for the fee master, including adjustments to vault assets.
